Article Title: 'Nobody can browbeat judiciary': SC issues notice to Rahul Gandhi, Akhilesh Yadav and others over October 12 march
Article Text:

NEW DELHI: The Supreme Court on Thursday issued notices to Rahul Gandhi , Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav and other protestors over their October 12 march to the apex court to protest alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.The bench, headed by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant and comprising Justice Joymalya Bagchi, said issuing notice on the petition did not mean it was condoning the conduct of the political leaders during the march.ALSO READ: Imran Khan asked to leave India: What rights do OCI cardholders have? “We will issue notice but we want to know his conduct on the next date of hearing,” the CJI said, referring to Rahul.During the hearing, Chief Justice of India Surya Kant said, “We are not sitting in ivory towers, we are aware of statements made outside the Court” after lawyers referred to attempts to “browbeat” the judiciary through the march. The CJI said the court would ask Rahul to explain how crowds entered the Supreme Court premises during the demonstration.The INDIA bloc’s ‘Chalo Dilli – March for Democracy’, led by Rahul, brought thousands of supporters into central Delhi on October 12. The opposition was demanding chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation and a halt to the SIR exercise over alleged electoral irregularities.The march saw supporters gather along roads between Connaught Place and the Supreme Court, waving party flags and raising slogans.Police stopped the procession near Barakhamba Road, where some demonstrators pushed through barricades as security personnel attempted to hold them back. The crowd later gathered along Bhagwan Das Road, with some supporters climbing onto parked police vehicles and buses.Rahul was joined by Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge, Priyanka Gandhi Vadra, Akhilesh Yadav, RJD leader Tejashwi Yadav and other INDIA bloc leaders. The procession followed the CJI’s refusal to meet opposition representatives seeking to submit a memorandum on alleged electoral irregularities. He had advised them to file a formal petition, citing matters already pending before the court.The opposition’s separate petition challenging the SIR process alleges arbitrary voter deletions and seeks greater transparency and safeguards in the revision of electoral rolls. The Supreme Court also issued notice to the Election Commission of India on that plea.
Article Summary: The Supreme Court on Thursday issued notices to Rahul Gandhi, Akhilesh Yadav and other protestors over their October 12 march to the apex court. The bench, headed by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant and comprising Justice Joymalya Bagchi, said issuing notice did not mean it was condoning the conduct of the political leaders.

Article Title: 'Stop politics of shoot and scoot': BJP slams Congress over readable electoral roll issue
Article Text:

NEW DELHI: Bharatiya Janata Party on Sunday accused Congress of pursuing "shoot and scoot" politics after the party claimed that the Election Commission had decided to provide "readable" electoral rolls to political parties because the whole nation was on the streets against the "vote chors". BJP spokesperson Pradeep Bhandari said Lok Sabha leader of opposition Rahul Gandhi was yet to file a formal complaint or submit an affidavit over his allegations last year about the entry of "1 lakh bogus voters" in Karnataka's Mahadevapura assembly segment, while pitching for searchable electoral rolls.This comes after Congress leader Jairam Ramesh said Rahul Gandhi and the grand old party had been "persistent, insistent and consistent" in demanding that the EC provide electoral rolls in a searchable format to all political parties for over two years."The demand was repeatedly refused by the ECI, which stopped providing searchable voter rolls in 2018 when Congress found lakhs of bogus voters in Madhya Pradesh. The demand was denied for 8 years to enable Vote Chori," Congress general secretary in charge of communications Ramesh alleged in a post on X.Ramesh said the EC issued an order on October 15 stating that electoral rolls would be provided in a searchable format to political parties for the Special Summary Revision (SSR), which had "resumed after a gap of two years in 17 states and UTs"."This is because the whole nation is on the streets against the Vote Chors," he claimed, alleging, "Every time Vote Chori is caught, the Modi govt adopts a new tactic: stopping readable voter rolls, fake voter additions, SIR. But not this time."Countering Ramesh, Bhandari said Rahul Gandhi had alleged the entry of "1 lakh bogus voters" in Karnataka's Mahadevapura assembly segment while pitching for searchable electoral rolls, but was yet to file a formal complaint or submit an affidavit in this connection."Mr Jairam Ramesh, your tweet explains that you are under confident with respect your case in Supreme Court," Bhandari said."Rahul Gandhi last year accused of 1 Lakh bogus entry in Mahadevpura, while pitching for searchable electoral roll; he has till date not given a formal complaint, nor an affidavit. Stop the politics of shoot & scoot!" he added.This comes after Rahul Gandhi, along with other opposition parties, filed a petition in the Supreme Court on October 12, alleging large-scale voter deletions and irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.
Article Summary: Bharatiya Janata Party accuses Congress of pursuing "shoot and scoot" politics. The party claims that the Election Commission had decided to provide "readable" electoral rolls to political parties. This comes after Congress leader Jairam Ramesh said Rahul Gandhi and the grand old party had been "persistent, insistent and consistent" in demanding that the EC provide electoral rolls.

Article Title: ‘Where did the 56-inch chest go?’ Rahul targets PM Modi, Shah in Goa, says BJP’s ‘expiry date’ is near

NEW DELHI: Congress leader and Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi on Sunday said Prime Minister Narendra Modi , Union Home Minister Amit Shah and Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar would face justice over alleged “vote chori”. Rahul also declared that the BJP’s “expiry date” was approaching.Addressing a public meeting in Margao, Goa, Rahul accused the BJP leadership of alleged electoral malpractice, corruption and targeting student protesters, while urging voters to give the Congress a full majority in the 2027 Assembly elections.“Gyanesh Kumar implements the theft of votes, Amit Shah operationalizes it, and Narendra Modi orchestrates the entire plan from behind the scenes,” Rahul said.He questioned why no defamation case had been filed against him specifically over his allegations of vote theft. “I am facing over 45 defamation cases—cases filed by Amit Shah, by Narendra Modi, and so on. Despite these 45 cases, I continue to state at every opportunity that Narendra Modi steals votes. Yet, no case has been filed against me specifically for this claim,” he said.Calling the Congress a protector of the Constitution, Gandhi said the three leaders would be held accountable.“Gyanesh Kumar knows that these people cannot escape accountability at the hands of the Congress party because we are the guardians and protectors of the Constitution. Safeguarding the Constitution is our duty,” he said.“Let me assure all Congress workers: PM Narendra Modi, Amit Shah and Gyanesh Kumar will face justice and will pay the price for what they have done.”Taking a swipe at the Prime Minister, Gandhi asked, “Where has his 56-inch chest gone? Perhaps you haven’t noticed, but have you seen Modi ji’s face lately? Where has his 56-inch chest gone? These days, Modi ji cannot even stand before us. He and Amit Shah know that the Congress party has taken them on and cornered them."Turning to student protests in Delhi, Gandhi said, “Look at what is happening in Delhi today. Pellet guns are being fired at students because they are raising concerns about vote theft, employment and the rising cost of education.”In Goa, Gandhi alleged widespread corruption, saying the state had been turned into a “model” for corruption. He urged voters to back the Congress, citing concerns over land conversion, alleged land grabbing, unemployment and the daily humiliation faced by residents.“The injustices you are suffering, the humiliation you face every day, and the way your land is being taken away from you and sold off — if you want to put a stop to all this, you must give the Congress party a full majority,” he said.Gandhi joined the Congress’s ‘Goy Rakhon Yatra’ in Margao, walking around two kilometres with party workers and leaders. The 27-day campaign, which began on September 22 and covered all 40 Assembly constituencies, concluded on Sunday.The Congress has positioned the yatra as a campaign to safeguard Goa’s land, environment, cultural heritage and identity.
Article Summary: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi accuses the BJP leadership of alleged electoral malpractice, corruption and targeting student protesters. Gandhi urges voters to give the Congress a full majority in the 2027 Assembly elections. He questioned why no defamation case had been filed against him specifically over his allegations of vote theft.

NEW DELHI: The bail hearing of Cockroach Janta Party functionaries Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka was put off Sunday after the special executive magistrate failed to arrive at the scheduled time, and later recused himself citing threat to his life. Delhi police registered a case in connection with the alleged threat. Police sources said the SEM had been pressured to release Ranka and Das without delay.CJP argued that the alleged threat was a separate complaint and suggested that police examine call detail records (CDRs) to ascertain whether the SEM’s number had been shared from a CJP member’s device. The magistrate declined.Das and Ranka were sent to five days of judicial custody on Oct 14 after they entered Jantar Mantar, which had been denotified as a designated protest site, by breaching barricades.CJP has alleged delay in the bail hearing, with the outfit’s legal head Ratna Singh also saying four sureties had been rejected on “vague grounds”. She posted on X that said she had been at the police station since 11am for the hearing, which was scheduled for noon, but the assistant commissioner of police, who also functions as the SEM, arrived around 5.30pm.Advocate Abhist Hela said no specific statutory provision was cited to reschedule the hearing, with the decision resting on concerns for judicial officers’ safety, among others.“Someone tried to influence him, and he (SEM) recused himself from the hearing today. How can he hear the case under such threatening circumstances?” a police officer said. The case has been registered under the provisions of Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) for alleged criminal intimidation and threatening a public servant.
Article Summary: The bail hearing of Cockroach Janta Party functionaries Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka was put off Sunday. The special executive magistrate failed to arrive at the scheduled time, and later recused himself citing threat to his life. Delhi police registered a case in connection with the alleged threat.

NEW DELHI: Senior Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) leader Indresh Kumar on Sunday urged citizens to remain vigilant against what he described as “ideologies that threaten the country’s unity and integrity” as he addressed the recent protests by opposition parties and the youth pressure group Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) against Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar."India must remain vigilant against ideologies that threaten its unity and integrity. … Any attempt to weaken India's unity, integrity and constitutional framework cannot be accepted," Kumar said at a conference of RSS affiliate Muslim Rashtriya Manch in Lucknow.Reacting to the opposition's protests, Kumar questioned whether the pursuit of political power could take precedence over the country's stability and national interests.“Spreading distrust in the electoral system and constitutional institutions is futile. … India needs responsible leadership, social harmony and nation-building, not confrontation and chaos,” he added.Citing the situations in Bangladesh and Pakistan, Kumar warned that violence, extremism, political confrontation and social divisions could undermine peace and stability in any country.The opposition and CJP have been demanding CEC Kumar’s resignation over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.Protests erupted in several parts of the country, particularly in Delhi, following a report by The Indian Express last month that the two Election Commissioners, Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi, had raised objections at least 14 times over the past 10 months to decisions they claimed had been taken without their knowledge.Congress MP and Lok Sabha leader of the opposition Rahul Gandhi, who has led opposition protests against the CEC, has repeatedly named RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat among five people he alleges have “hijacked” national institutions. The other four are Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Union home minister Amit Shah, Gyanesh Kumar and National Security Advisor Ajit Doval.The RSS is the ideological mentor of the ruling BJP.
Article Summary: Senior Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) leader Indresh Kumar urged citizens to remain vigilant against what he described as “ideologies that threaten the country’s unity and integrity” Opposition parties and the youth pressure group Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) have been demanding CEC Gyanesh Kumar's resignation over alleged irregularities.

NEW DELHI: Actor Aamir Khan met Maharashtra Navnirman Sena (MNS) chief Raj Thackeray on Sunday, visiting the politician amid legal troubles faced by the superstar’s nephew, actor Imran Khan , over participation in a political protest despite being a US citizen.Aamir Khan met Raj Thackeray at the MNS chief’s residence, Shivtirth, near Shivaji Park in Mumbai’s Dadar area.An MNS functionary, however, asserted the meeting had no connection to Imran Khan’s legal troubles. According to the functionary, Aamir Khan and Raj Thackeray share a close relationship and meet frequently.In photographs circulating on social media, the two can be seen chatting on the balcony of the MNS chief’s residence.In July, Raj Thackeray was among the guests who attended Aamir Khan’s wedding to his long-time partner, Gauri Spratt.Imran Khan, who was born in the US in 1983 and holds an Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) card, has been issued a notice by Mumbai Policedirecting him to leave India by October 28 over his participation in a demonstration demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Article Title: Ludhiana school horror: Peon gropes, kisses 16-year-old student in office, records video

The teacher reportedly asked her to collect the book from the teacher’s office.The girl’s mother alleged that when her daughter entered the office to look for the book, the accused who worked as a peon at the school, arrived there. Article Summary: A school peon has been arrested for molesting a 16-year-old student inside the premises. The complaint also alleges that the accused recorded a video of the girl. The Tibba police have registered a case against the accused under Section 75 of BNS.

Article Title: ‘Stop protecting the VIP’: Ankita Bhandari's parents detained after overnight protest over governor appointment
Article Text:
Congress backs parents as Delhi Police break up overnight dharna

After an overnight vigil at India Gate, a pre-dawn swoop by Delhi Police brought the dharna for “Justice to Ankita Bhandari” to an end. The cops arrived at the protest site at 4 am and took away the wailing parents of Ankita Bhandari, who was murdered in Uttarakhand in 2022.Rahul Gandhi, Priyanka Gandhi Vadra and, later, AICC general secretary KC Venugopal visited the protest site on Wednesday evening to express solidarity with the parents. After they left, scores of Congress MPs, MLAs and workers of the Youth Congress and NSUI, among others, joined the dharna. Uttarakhand MLA and Congress office-bearer Qazi Nizamuddin, MPs Pawan Khera, Jothi Mani and Imran Pratapgarhi, Congress spokespersons Supriya Shrinate, Gurdeep Sappal and Ragini Nayak, Youth Congress president Uday Bhanu Chib, NSUI president Vinod Jakhar and Mahila Congress president Alka Lamba, among others, joined the vigil, which continued until early morning before being disrupted by the cops.Videos of the police action went viral, with Chib, Jakhar and others even trying to intercept the bus carrying the detainees.Ankita’s parents arrived from Uttarakhand on Wednesday evening and sat on a dharna along with activist Yogita Bhayana, holding a placard that read, “Stop protecting the VIP”. The continuing controversy over Ankita’s murder received a fresh lease of life with the appointment of BJP leader Dushyant Gautam as governor.The controversy revolves around the “VIP” who had allegedly sought “special service” at the infamous resort then owned by the son of a BJP leader. Ankita resisted the pressure. Her body was found in a canal in 2022, leading to a murder case.In a social media post, the Congress said there were allegations that Gautam was the “VIP” in question. “Narendra Modi has rewarded Gautam with the governorship of Sikkim. The girls and women of the country are watching how Modi and his govt are protecting Gautam.Instead of giving them justice, the entire BJP govt is hellbent on suppressing the voice of Ankita’s parents,” it said.Ankita’s father urged the President of India to put Gautam’s appointment as governor on hold until the CBI inquiry into the issue is completed.Ankita’s parents were taken by the cops to Tilak Marg police station, where they were swiftly joined by Congress leaders protesting the police action against the parents, who were seeking justice for their deceased daughter.
Article Summary: Rahul Gandhi, Priyanka Gandhi Vadra and AICC general secretary KC Venugopal visited the protest site on Wednesday evening. Scores of Congress MPs, MLAs and workers of the Youth Congress and NSUI, among others, joined the dharna.

INDIA bloc's anti-SIR protest at Egmore, Chennai.





KOLATHUR: VCK leader Thol Thirumavalavan claimed that DMK leader and former chief minister MK Stalin suffered an electoral defeat in the Kolathur constituency due to mass voter deletions carried out during the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise.Speaking at a joint demonstration organised by the INDIA bloc against the Election Commission of India (ECI) and the implementation of SIR, Thirumavalavan accused the BJP of weaponising the revision process to target political rivals. He alleged that similar electoral roll manipulations had been used against prominent opposition leaders, including West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee and Kerala chief minister Pinarayi Vijayan.The protest saw participation from key INDIA bloc partners, including leaders from the Congress, Left parties, MDMK and IUML.Joining the demonstration, TVK leader and minister A Rajmohan reiterated his party’s opposition to the exercise, stating that TVK had consistently opposed the implementation of SIR since its inception.
Article Summary: VCK leader Thol Thirumavalavan claimed that DMK leader and former chief minister MK Stalin suffered an electoral defeat in the Kolathur constituency due to mass voter deletions carried out during the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise. He accused the BJP of weaponising the revision process to target political rivals.

Article Title: Police seize 52kg ganja hidden in bed, arrest 2
Article Text:
New Delhi:





Police have found 49 packets containing 52.32 kg of ganja concealed inside a bed’s storage compartment in a house in west Delhi ’s Mohan Garden and arrested two men.The bust followed an initial seizure of 1.8 kg of ganja from an abandoned scooter in Najafgarh. On Oct 7, police teams were patrolling near Tiranga Chowk when a suspicious person left behind the scooter and fled. The ganja was found in its trunk.Police apprehended the person, Balbir (45), on Oct 10 and found 200 gm of ganja on him. During interrogation, he disclosed information regarding a larger stock concealed at a house in Mohan Garden’s Sidharth Enclave.“Acting on the information, a raid was conducted at the house on Oct 11. Over 52 kg of ganja, packed in 49 packets, was found inside a storage compartment of a bed. A man, Ranju, 35, suspected to be a supplier of the drug, was arrested,” said DCP Kushal Pal Singh.Further investigation is underway to trace the source of the contraband and establish the supply chain. Police are trying to identify and apprehend others involved in the network.
Article Summary: Police have found 49 packets containing 52.32 kg of ganja concealed inside a bed’s storage compartment in a house in west Delhi ’s Mohan Garden and arrested two men. The bust followed an initial seizure of 1.8 kg ofGanja from an abandoned scooter in Najafgarh.

Article Title: Tiger Shroff firing: Mumbai Crime Branch nabs all 3 shooters in Kota
Article Text:
Mumbai Crime Branch detained a suspect in the shooting incident involving actor Tiger Shroff's car





KOTA: Kota Police on Monday detained three people, including a minor, in connection with the firing at Bollywood actor Tiger Shroff’s vehicle in Mumbai’s Juhu area. The accused were apprehended at Kota Junction while allegedly attempting to flee Mumbai.Kota police chief Tejaswani Gautam said a team was formed following technical inputs and intelligence about the suspects’ movements. Personnel from Railway Colony and Bhimganjmandi police stations, the District Special Team, Cyber Cell and AGTF were part of the operation.The accused have been identified as Rehan alias Sukka, 18, a resident of Sonepat in Haryana; Hrithik Kumar alias Roshan Fighter, 22, originally from Bihar and currently residing in Andheri West, Mumbai; and a minor.According to Kota Police, the three were apprehended within the railway station premises during a coordinated operation. They are being questioned, and Mumbai Police and the relevant investigating agencies have been informed for further legal action.The firing case was initially registered at Juhu police station before being transferred to the Mumbai Crime Branch for further investigation.Police are investigating the accused's alleged roles in the incident and the circumstances surrounding the firing.
Article Summary: Kota Police detained three people, including a minor, in connection with the firing at Bollywood actor Tiger Shroff’s vehicle. The accused were apprehended at Kota Junction while allegedly attempting to flee Mumbai. They are being questioned, and Mumbai Police and the relevant investigating agencies have been informed for further legal action.

Article Title: ​Aurangabad Graduate Constituency poll: Sena takes U-turn to support NCP candidate; Sattar defies party line
Article Text:
Shiv Sena MLA Abdul Sattar campaigning for NCP (SP) candidate at Kannad on Saturday

Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar:





Two days after announcing the withdrawal of support for NCP candidate Satish Chavan in Aurangabad Graduates’ Constituency poll, Shiv Sena minister Sanjay Shirsat on Saturday took a U-turn, stating that his party will, in fact, back the NCP candidate.However, no sooner had Shirsat changed his mind than Shiv Sena’s Sillod MLA and former cabinet minister, Abdul Sattar , took a contradictory stance by announcing his support for NCP (SP) candidate Pratapsinh Patil.Shirsat had initially withdrawn support for Chavan due to escalating tensions in Amravati Division Teachers’ Constituency. There, NCP MLC Sanjay Khodke and his wife, Amravati NCP MLA Sulbha Khodke, had allegedly openly extended their support to Vidarbha Madhyamik Shikshak Sangh candidate Dilip Kadu against official Shiv Sena nominee, Kiran Sarnaik.Speaking at a joint news conference with Chavan on Saturday, Shirsat said the NCP leadership from Amravati had since assured top Mahayuti leaders that they would not support any candidate other than Sarnaik. “Following their assurance, we have decided to vote for NCP candidate again in the Aurangabad Graduates’ Constituency poll,” Shirsat said.Meanwhile, defying the party’s official position, Sattar went ahead and organised a meeting of party workers in Sillod to rally support for the rival NCP (SP) candidate.Addressing the gathering, he appealed to voters to cast their valuable first-preference votes for Pratapsinh Patil.The NCP camp had not issued an official response to the Shiv Sena MLA’s rebellious stance as of Saturday evening.The upcoming Oct 23 triangular contest for the MLC seat features candidates from both factions of NCP alongside Dilip Ghuge of Shiv Sena (UBT). While internal rebellion by Sattar is rocking the Mahayuti alliance, the opposition Maha Vikas Aghadi (MVA) is witnessing its own internal friction, with allies NCP (SP) and Shiv Sena (UBT) fighting against one another.
Article Summary: Shiv Sena minister Sanjay Shirsat on Saturday took a U-turn, stating that his party will, in fact, back the NCP candidate. Shiv Sena’s Sillod MLA and former cabinet minister, Abdul Sattar, took a contradictory stance by announcing his support for NCP (SP) candidate Pratapsinh Patil.

Article Title: Sule alleges ‘vote chori’, seeks poll reforms; questions govt’s farmer aid promise
Article Text:
Supriya Sule

Kolhapur

:

Independent candidate claims Sena support





NCP (SP) MP Supriya Sule on Friday alleged large-scale manipulation of voter lists and called for electoral reforms to ensure fairness and a level playing field in elections.“In cooperative elections, voter lists are prepared months in advance. In general elections, however, the process remains open till the last moment. While political parties are busy campaigning, names are allegedly being added to and deleted from voter lists,” she said while addressing a press conference in Kolhapur while campaigning for Congress and NCP (SP) candidates in the Pune graduates’ and teachers’ constituency elections.Sule compared alleged electoral malpractice to clearing an examination through copying. “Don’t pass an exam by copying. Today, many people feel that ‘vote chori’ has taken place on a large scale. That is why a massive number of people turned up when an opposition delegation approached Supreme Court with a petition,” she said.The MP also targeted Centre over the economy, claiming that govt was being forced to sell profitable public sector undertakings. Referring to the proposed disinvestment of IDBI Bank, she alleged that the economy was under severe stress.“The reality is that the economy has slowed significantly. RBI reserves have been used on an unprecedented scale to stabilise the dollar, while food inflation continues to soar,” she said.Sule also questioned chief minister Devendra Fadnavis ’s reported assurance of providing Rs 5,000 to farmers for Diwali. She sought clarity on whether the proposed assistance would be over and above pending instalments under the Namo Shetkari Yojana. “Pay the pending dues separately and provide the Rs 5,000 separately. Farmers should not be misled,” she said, while reiterating her demand for compensation of Rs 1 lakh per hectare for drought-hit farmers.Independent candidate Sachin Sanap, contesting from Pune teachers’ constituency, claimed in Kolhapur that Shiv Sena workers and members were campaigning for him despite deputy chief minister Eknath Shinde’s backing for the BJP candidate.Sanap, a former officer on special duty to minister and Sena leader Uday Samant, remained in the fray after refusing to withdraw his candidature. The party’s official nominee, Mangesh Chivate, withdrew from the contest at the last moment.
Article Summary: NCP (SP) MP Supriya Sule alleged large-scale manipulation of voter lists. She was campaigning for Congress and NCP candidates in the Pune graduates’ and teachers’ constituency elections. Sule compared alleged electoral malpractice to clearing an examination through copying.

Article Title: Rs 1 lakh bribe trap: Navi Mumbai ACB catches circle officer, talathi and woman assistant
Article Text:
The arrested accused were identified as Keshav Dagdu Mohite, Jaihind Birsha Koli (49) and Monika Vijnesh Patil (36).





NAVI MUMBAI: The Navi Mumbai Anti-Corruption Bureau (ACB) has arrested two revenue officials and a woman assistant for allegedly accepting a Rs 1 lakh bribe from a villager in Chirner, Uran taluka, to register the names of his relatives in the 7/12 extract of a land record.The arrested accused were identified as Keshav Dagdu Mohite (52), circle officer at Koproli in Uran taluka; Jaihind Birsha Koli (49), talathi; and Monika Vijnesh Patil (36), an assistant to the revenue officials.Dharmaraj Sonake, deputy superintendent of police, Navi Mumbai ACB, said the complainant had applied to register the names of the heirs of his deceased sister in the 7/12 extract of their land in Chirner.The land was jointly owned by the complainant's maternal uncle, aunt, brother and sister. The complainant had also applied for deletion of his deceased brother's name and submitted the request to circle officer Mohite and talathi Koli. However, the two officials allegedly demanded Rs 1 lakh from him to process the work.Dy SP Sonake said, "After verification of the complaint on Monday, when it was confirmed that the revenue officers Mohite and Koli had told the complainant to hand over the bribe amount to the accused woman assistant Monika Patil, a trap was laid on Tuesday around 2 pm. After the woman assistant Monika Patil accepted the demanded bribe of Rs 1 lakh from the complainant and handed it over to circle officer Keshav Mohite, both were caught red-handed and arrested. While, the acccused Talathi Jaihind Koli who was involved in the bribe demand was taken into custody from Dronagiri."
Article Summary: The Navi Mumbai Anti-Corruption Bureau (ACB) has arrested two revenue officials and a woman assistant for allegedly accepting a Rs 1 lakh bribe. The arrested accused were identified as Keshav Dagdu Mohite (52), circle officer at Koproli in Uran taluka; Jaihind Birsha Koli (49), talathi; and Monika Vijnesh Patil (36)

Article Title: Man in Mahindra Thar with duplicate plate molests woman, knocks down another in Kharghar
Article Text:
30-year-old man was apprehended for allegedly molesting a woman and injuring another in Navi Mumbai.





NAVI MUMBAI: A 30-year-old man wearing a mask and driving a red Thar SUV with a duplicate registration number plate was apprehended by the Crime Branch Unit-3 team within 10 hours on Thursday evening.He had allegedly molested a 26-year-old woman walking on the street in Kharghar, around 400metres from Pethpada metro station, on September 30 night and, an hour later, severely injured a 22-year-old woman by knocking her down in Belpada, Sector 3, Kharghar.Acting on a complaint by the woman allegedly molested by the Thar SUV driver, Kharghar police registered an FIR under BNS section 74 for the offence of assault or criminal force against a woman with the intent to outrage her modesty.While, as per the complaint by the injured woman Shrawani Dandekar, a resident of sector 3, Belpada, an FIR under relevant BNS sections and Motor Vehicle Act was registered against the Thar SUV driver for rash and negligent driving causing hurt.The detained aaccused identified as Ali alias Talib Ahsan Nakhvi, a resident of sector 50, Seawoods, Nerul was handed over to Kharghar police for further legal action.Previously, in January 2021, he was arrested by Nerul police in the FIR registered against him for alleged kidnapping, sexual harassment and molestation of a woman.Sanjay Joshi, senior inspector of Kharghar said, "The accused Nakhvi has been detained and subsequently it will be decided whether to arrest him or serve with a notice under Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) for cooperating in police investigating."Audumbar Patil, senior inspector of crime branch unit-3 said, "After an FIR for molestation was registered at Kharghar police station by the victim woman, a resident of sector 34, Kharghar. As per the orders of higher authority, our team started a parallel probe. From the CCTV camera surveillance near the crime scene, we obtained the red Thar SUV's registration number, which was of Vashi RTO passing.""When verified, the registration number was found to be that of a Maruti WagonR car. As the accused had used a duplicate registration number plate, we scrutinized as many as 62 Thar SUVs registered with various Regional Transport Offices (RTOs). Subsequently, we obtained the registration number of a red Thar SUV that was registered with Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar RTO," Patil added.SPI Patil further informed, "The SUV was registered in the name of Ali alias Talib Ahsan Nakhvi, a resident of Devaki Apartment in sector-50, Seawoods. From his mobile number registered with the RTO, his location was tracked.""He was apprehended from Bonkode village, Koparkhairane on Thursday late evening. Upon thorough interrogation, he confessed that he had inappropriately touched the woman pedestrian near Pethpada metro station while he drove his Thar SUV and sped away. He even confessed to have injured a woman pedestrian by hitting her his SUV while driving in Belpada area," he said.
Article Summary: A 30-year-old man wearing a mask and driving a red Thar SUV with a duplicate registration number plate was apprehended by the Crime Branch Unit-3 team on Thursday evening. He had allegedly molested a woman walking on the street in Kharghar, around 400metres from Pethpada metro station, on September 30 night. An hour later, he severely injured a woman by knocking her down in Belpada, Sector 3, KharGHar.

Article Title: 2 women escape from RPF lockup in Navi Mumbai; 1 held after 6 hours, cop suspended
Article Text:
The women removed their sarees, tied one end to the generator on the balcony and climbed down before escaping. (AI image)





NAVI MUMBAI: In a major security lapse at Belapur Railway Protection Force (RPF), two women arrested for allegedly attempting to steal overhead electric wires from the Juinagar railway godown escaped from the lockup after midnight on September 28.One of them was apprehended around six hours later, while the other remains at large.The woman constable on night duty has been suspended and a departmental inquiry has been initiated against her.As per the FIR registered by RPF sub-inspector Milap Parte (52) at Panvel GRP, a case was registered on September 24 under Section 3(a) of the Railway Property (Unauthorized Possession) Act, 1966, Amendment 2012, at Belapur railway police station.The case was based on a written memo submitted by RPF personnel Ravikant Gade regarding the theft of overhead electric wires from the godown at Juinagar railway station on September 21.During the probe, a trap was laid on September 26 and around 1pm, two women were found loitering suspiciously near the Juinagar godown with the alleged intention of committing theft.They were taken into custody and identified as Rupali Kailas Kurhade (30), from Jalna, and Shalibai Ashok Pawar (49), from Bhiwandi.They were arrested after an FIR was registered for attempted theft and produced before a CSMT court, which remanded them to police custody till September 30. They were lodged in the lockup at Belapur RPF police station.Day-shift woman constable Rakhi Malaiya was assigned guard duty at the lockup, after which woman head constable Pooja Bagre was on night duty.Around 2am on September 28, when Bagre had gone to the toilet, the two women allegedly managed to open the lock by inserting their hands through the iron bars of the lockup and jerking it. Police suspect the lock may not have been secured properly.The women then reached the balcony at the rear end of the police station. They removed their sarees, tied one end to the generator on the balcony and climbed down before escaping.The incident was captured on CCTV footage. PSI Parte learnt about the escape after waking up at home around 6.30am and finding several missed calls from head constable Bagre and ASI Rajiv Parsan.Sunil Nila, chief spokesperson of Central Railway, said, "One accused woman Rupali Kurhade was apprehended from near Nerul railway station around 8.45 am. The other accused Shalibai Pawar is still absconding."
Article Summary: The women removed their sarees, tied one end to the generator on the balcony and climbed down before escaping. One of them was apprehended around six hours later, while the other remains at large. The woman constable on night duty has been suspended and a departmental inquiry has been initiated.

Article Title: Ulhasnagar social activist Haresh Gajwani shot dead outside railway station, 3 arrested
Article Text:
Haresh Gajwani was murdered outside Ulhasnagar railway station on Wednesday night.





ULHASNAGAR: Police have arrested three suspects in connection with the murder of social worker Haresh Gajwani, who was shot dead outside Ulhasnagar railway station on Wednesday night. The suspects have been identified as Avinash Naidu, Vijay Singh and Noor Alam Khan.According to preliminary investigations, Gajwani and Naidu had a long-standing dispute. In 2021, counter-cases were registered against the two sides following a dispute, which allegedly contributed to continuing tensions between Gajwani and the accused.Police said the three suspects were traced and detained with the help of CCTV footage. Investigators are examining the alleged past rivalry, along with other possible motives behind the murder.Gajwani, 54, was allegedly attacked by three assailants who fired two rounds at him before fleeing the scene. Locals and police took him to Central Hospital, where doctors declared him "brought dead".Recently, Gajwani had posted on X, tagging senior officials from various police departments, as well as the chief minister, deputy chief minister and FDA commissioner Tukaram Mundhe. In his posts, he had highlighted alleged illegal activities in the area and claimed that some police personnel were supporting those involved. He had also expressed fears for his life, warning that the police personnel he had accused would also be responsible if anything happened to him.
Article Summary: Haresh Gajwani, 54, was shot dead outside Ulhasnagar railway station on Wednesday. Police have arrested three suspects in connection with the murder. The suspects have been identified as Avinash Naidu, Vijay Singh and Noor Alam Khan. Investigators are examining the alleged past rivalry, along with other possible motives.

Article Title: Regime change possible only through polls, says Fadnavis
Article Text:
CM Devendra Fadnavis addressing MLC poll campaign on Sunday in Nagpur

Nagpur:





Chief minister Devendra Fadnavis on Sunday said those hoping for a regime change in India through street protests, as seen in Nepal and Bangladesh, would never succeed, asserting that Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar’s Constitution governs the country.“Stop fighting the Constitution of India. Such decisions will be taken in Parliament and in accordance with the Constitution, not on the streets. In a democracy, such decisions are made through elections,” he said in Nagpur.“In India, regime change happens only through the ballot. If you want a change, you will have to contest elections, win people’s hearts and secure a mandate,” Fadnavis added.Taking a dig at Shiv Sena (UBT) president Uddhav Thackeray over his regime change remark, Fadnavis said, “I am not sure which change he is talking about, because Uddhav ji did not even come to know about the regime change in his own party until after it had happened.”
Article Summary: Chief minister Devendra Fadnavis said those hoping for a regime change in India through street protests would never succeed. “Stop fighting the Constitution of India. Such decisions will be taken in Parliament and in accordance with the Constitution, not on the streets,” he said in Nagpur.

Article Title: Vijay’s visit to Thrissur cancelled due to heavy rain in Coimbatore
Article Text:
CM Vijay





COIMBATORE: Tamil Nadu chief minister C Joseph Vijay ’s planned visit to Kerala was cancelled on Friday due to heavy rain and adverse weather conditions in Coimbatore.Vijay was scheduled to travel by helicopter to Thrissur in Kerala after inaugurating the Periyar Arivulagam Library and Science Centre in Coimbatore. He was expected to attend a Navaratri celebration at the residence of a prominent jewellery businessman in Kerala.Two helicopters were stationed at the temporary helipads on the Police Recruitment School ground for the trip. However, the weather disrupted the planned journey, leading to its cancellation. Vijay later left for Chennai.
Article Summary: Vijay was scheduled to travel by helicopter to Thrissur in Kerala after inaugurating the Periyar Arivulagam Library and Science Centre in Coimbatore. He was expected to attend a Navaratri celebration at the residence of a prominent jewellery businessman.

Article Title: 864 bottles of liquor seized from house near Erode; man arrested
Article Text: ERODE: Police seized 864 bottles of Indian made foreign liquor (IMFL) from a house near Mylambadi in Erode district in the early hours of Thursday and arrested a man.Acting on a tip-off that bottles of liquor had been illegally stored for unauthorised sale, the Bhavani police conducted a raid at the house of K Govindaraj, 28, of Ammapalayam. They found 864 bottles of IMFL stocked in the house for illegal sale.Police registered a case and arrested Govindaraj. He was remanded in judicial custody.They launched a search for Sekar alias Ammasai, 34, and Sridhar, 38, who have links with the illegal liquor operation.
Article Summary: Police seized 864 bottles of Indian made foreign liquor (IMFL) from a house near Mylambadi in Erode district. Acting on a tip-off that bottles of liquor had been illegally stored for unauthorised sale, the Bhavani police conducted a raid.

Article Title: Man dies after falling from tree in Madurai
Article Text:
Man dies after falling from tree in Madurai

Madurai

:





A 47-year-old man died after falling from a tree while cutting branches near Kalavasal Bypass Road in Madurai on Sunday.The deceased, Vijayakumar of Thirumangalam, was working near a ration shop off Kalavasal Bypass Road when he reportedly slipped and fell from a height equivalent to a two-storey building.He sustained severe injuries and was being rushed to a private hospital by his co-workers when he died on the way.SS Colony police registered a case and are investigating.

Article Title: Tirunelveli police seize 600 tablets, arrest three
Article Text:
Tirunelveli police seize 600 tablets, arrest three

Tirunelveli:





Police seized 600 tablets of tapentadol and nitrazepam and arrested three people, while a juvenile was taken into protective custody, for allegedly possessing the medicines illegally for use as intoxicants.Acting on a tip-off, police intercepted four people standing suspiciously near the IIPE school bus stop, within the limits of the Tirunelveli Taluk police station, on Saturday. They were identified as Rishikesh , 19, and Vijay Aadithan, 22, both from Chennai; Janakiraman , 21, from Arakkonam; and a juvenile from Chennai.During a search, police allegedly found 600 tablets packed in 60 strips. The medicines are meant for medical use only on the recommendation of a registered medical practitioner.The Tirunelveli Taluk police registered a case and arrested the three adults, who were remanded in judicial custody. The juvenile was taken into protective custody, and further proceedings are under way under the provisions of the Juvenile Justice Act.
Article Summary: Police seized 600 tablets of tapentadol and nitrazepam and arrested three people. A juvenile was taken into protective custody for allegedly possessing the medicines illegally for use as intoxicants. The medicines are meant for medical use only on the recommendation of a registered medical practitioner.

Article Title: EPS lost moral right to enter AIADMK hq: Nirmal Kumar
Article Text:
EPS lost moral right to enter AIADMK hq: Nirmal Kumar





Madurai: Minister for energy resources C T R Nirmal Kumar on Saturday accused AIADMK general secretary Edappadi K Palaniswami of reducing his party to a “letterhead party,” and said he had lost the moral right to enter the AIADMK headquarters.Addressing reporters after inaugurating the state-level Chief Minister’s Trophy sports meet at MGR Stadium in Madurai, the minister said several senior AIADMK leaders had already voiced concerns about Palaniswami’s style of functioning.“AIA DMK has been turned into a letter-pad party to safeguard the interests and properties of Edappadi Palaniswami’s family. He has mortgaged the party to DMK and abandoned it midway. The AIADMK headquarters is MGR’s legacy, and he does not even have the eligibility to enter the building,” Nirmal Kumar said.Alleging that AIADMK legislators had once explored the possibility of joining hands with DMK to form a govt, he said, “Not even a brick of the party headquarters would accept Palaniswami’s decisions. Byelections were necessitated because of him, and AIADMK legislators have been politically confined to the MLA hostel.”The minister further claimed that Palaniswami remained inaccessible even to party functionaries. “Very few people have his phone number, and most leaders cannot contact him. That is why CM Vijay was able to meet other leaders but not him,” he said.On allegations surrounding Tamil Nadu’s power procurement policy, Nirmal Kumar said several states, including Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and West Bengal, had also purchased electricity at rates of up to Rs 35 per unit. “Tamil Nadu has procured power only under contractual arrangements,” he said.He said the electricity department was fully prepared to handle the northeast monsoon in 14 districts and no govt welfare scheme would be stalled for want of funds. Nirmal Kumar said the govt was considering legislative amendments relating to reservation benefits for converted Muslims and consultations were held with various Muslim organisations in this regard.
Article Summary: C T R Nirmal Kumar accused Edappadi K Palaniswami of reducing his party to a ‘letterhead party’ He said he had lost the moral right to enter the AIADMK headquarters. “Not even a brick of the party headquarters would accept Palan iswami’s decisions,” he said.

Article Title: 6 kg ganja seized, 3 arrested

6 kg ganja seized, 3 arrested

Three mobile phones, four weapons and a two-wheeler used for transporting the contraband were also seized.Acting on a tip, a police team led by inspector Mayil and SSI Arun was conducting a search at Vaigai Periyar Nagar when they noticed three people trying to hide. Article Title: Traffic affected on Salem-Madurai National Highway after trailer truck crashes near Rasipuram
Article Text: NAMAKKAL: Traffic was affected for more than an hour on the Salem-Madurai National Highway near Rasipuram in Namakkal district on Thursday afternoon after a trailer truck crashed while descending the Andagalur Gate flyover.No casualties or injuries were reported.The truck was carrying about 60 tonnes of steel angles from Maharashtra to Karur. An officer at the Rasipuram police station said the driver lost control of the vehicle while descending the flyover around 1.30pm. The truck hit a streetlight pole on the roadside. “The vehicle partially blocked the road, causing congestion and delays for motorists and commuters,” he said.Vehicles piled up for two kilometres on the NH. The Rasipuram police reached the spot after receiving information, regulated traffic and moved the truck to the roadside.Police registered a case and were investigating the circumstances leading to the crash.
Article Summary: Trailer truck crashes on Salem-Madurai National Highway near Rasipuram. Truck was carrying 60 tonnes of steel angles from Maharashtra to Karur. Driver lost control of the vehicle while descending the flyover. No casualties or injuries were reported.

Article Title: Trust cannot file consumer complaint: Commission
Article Text:
Kochi

:





Kerala State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission has held that a trust is not a “person” under Consumer Protection Act and hence the trust cannot be a complainant under the Act.A bench comprising Justice B Sudheendra Kumar (president), Ajith Kumar D (judicial member) and K R Radhakrishnan (member) clarified in the order dated Sept 16 that even if a precedent laid down by the apex court relating to the matter has been referred to a larger bench, the established law continues to govern until overridden or modified.The case arose from a consumer complaint instituted before District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (DCDRC), Ernakulam, by Cochin Thirumala Devaswom Committee against the opposite party, Anand G. Kamath (M/s Lalit Boiler Works). P Rahul appeared for the opposite party.The opposite party filed an interlocutory application challenging the maintainability of the complaint on the ground that the complainant was a trust. The complainant acknowledged its trust status but maintained that the complaint remained maintainable. The district commission subsequently dismissed the opposite party’s application and upheld the complaint’s maintainability, prompting the revision petition before the state commission.Reversing the decision of the district commission, the state commission relied on Supreme Court ruling in Prathibha Pratisthan v. Manager, Canara Bank, which held that a trust does not fall within the definition of a “person” under Consumer Protection Act.Addressing the complainant’s contention regarding the reference made to a larger bench, the state commission emphasised that mere reference to a larger bench does not stay or invalidate the binding nature of an existing precedent.
Article Summary: Kerala State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission has held that a trust is not a ‘person’ under Consumer Protection Act. A bench comprising Justice B Sudheendra Kumar, Ajith Kumar D (judicial member) and K R Radhakrishnan (member) clarified in the order dated Sept 16.

Article Title: Nedumbassery accident: Angamaly joint RTO serves notice on Suhail
Article Text:
Suhail Sajeev

Kochi

:





Angamaly joint RTO served a notice on Suhail Sajeev, the main accused in the Nedumbasserry accident case, asking him for reasons why his driving licence should not be suspended. The move is part of normal procedures to suspend a driving licence.Police had recommended that the motor vehicles department (MVD) suspend the licence of Suhail, the first accused in the luxury car crash in which three youngsters were killed. MVD asked Suhail to reply to the notice in 14 days.Besides reckless driving on Suhail’s part, the silencer of his vehicle was found modified to create excess noise, causing pollution.
Article Summary: Suhail Sajeev is the first accused in the luxury car crash in which three youngsters were killed. The silencer of his vehicle was found modified to create excess noise, causing pollution. MVD asked Suhail to reply to the notice in 14 days.
